questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means the lane you are in will leave the freeway. You can either change lanes to continue on the freeway, or stay in your lane and exit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangular sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A circular sign warns you of a railroad crossing ahead. Watch for trains and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road. If you see this sign, traffic is moving toward you. Do not enter—turn around.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow diamond-shaped warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that wet pavement can be slippery and make it harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a full stop and look both ways before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You may see this sign at intersections where U-turns would be unsafe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk where pedestrians cross the road. Watch for people crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign requires you to drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic from the right will be merging into your lane. Be prepared to make room for merging vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will merge into your lane. Check your mirrors and side before moving to another lane if possible. Give merging drivers space to enter the traffic flow safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to yield or stop before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there’s a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always give pedestrians the right-of-way when they are in or entering a crosswalk. Watch carefully for pedestrians at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed. Do not turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs are used only for construction and maintenance warnings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downhill slope ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: Speed limit signs show the maximum legal speed for that road. However, you may need to drive slower when conditions are poor such as bad weather or traffic. Always drive at a safe speed for current conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: This sign means you must give other drivers and pedestrians the right-of-way. Slow down and let traffic cross in front of you. Stop if necessary before continuing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic flows in both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it means an action is prohibited. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Motorcyclists can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and points downward, it means the rider will slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. Then proceed only when it is safe. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop where you can see oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided roadway is ending. You are approaching a two-way highway where traffic flows in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. You cannot turn around and go in the opposite direction where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming up. Slow down and prepare to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. You must come to a complete stop. Do not proceed until it is clear and safe to pass through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Reduce your speed to avoid brake damage or crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the entrance to one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot drive in that direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic moves only in the direction the arrow points.
